def solve(case):
    lengths = case['lengths']
    scores = case['scores']
    budget = case['budget']
    n = len(lengths)
    dp = [(0, []) for _ in range(budget+1)]
    for i in range(n):
        l = lengths[i]
        s = scores[i]
        for w in range(budget, l-1, -1):
            if dp[w-l][0] + s > dp[w][0]:
                dp[w] = (dp[w-l][0] + s, dp[w-l][1] + [i])
    best_score = 0
    best_indices = []
    for w in range(budget+1):
        if dp[w][0] > best_score:
            best_score = dp[w][0]
            best_indices = dp[w][1]
    tokens_used = sum(lengths[i] for i in best_indices)
    return {
        "selected_indices": best_indices,
        "tokens_used": tokens_used,
        "total_score": best_score
    }
